trigger: Reach the Authority checkpoint on the Blatnik bridge.

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: Jersey barriers. A Humvee with no fuel, used as a wall. A corporal with a clipboard.

nodes.speaker: cpl_haas
nodes.text: Morning. ID and sector. Anything to declare, declare it.

nodes.speaker: cpl_haas
nodes.text: Then I search you, and we both have a worse morning.

nodes.speaker: cpl_haas
nodes.text: Kowalczyk. Lineworker? Huh. They want your kind registered first.

nodes.speaker: cpl_haas
nodes.text: Bag check. Meds over thirty days go to the hospital pool. Sorry.

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: He takes the pharmacy bag. He leaves Theo's insulin. 'Personal use. Keep it cold.'

nodes.speaker: cpl_haas
nodes.text: ...Camels. God. Okay. Go. You never saw me smile.

nodes.speaker: cpl_haas
nodes.text: DECC's past Canal Park. Line starts at the parking ramp. Bring patience.
